title: Security Analyst Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to move from zero knowledge to a job‑ready security analyst. It covers fundamentals, core security skills, portfolio projects, and job preparation.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build the essential networking and Linux base needed for security work.

milestones.title: Networking Basics
milestones.outcome: Explain how data moves across networks and identify common protocols.

tasks.title: Read TCP/IP overview
tasks.description: Study the TCP/IP model and key protocols on MDN’s Networking guide.

tasks.title: Watch networking video series
tasks.description: Complete the freeCodeCamp ‘Networking Basics’ playlist (first 3 videos).

tasks.title: Configure a home router
tasks.description: Log into your router, note IP scheme, and enable DHCP logging.

tasks.title: Summarize protocol roles
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of HTTP, DNS, and DHCP functions.

milestones.title: Linux Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Navigate the command line, manage files, and install packages on a Linux distro.

tasks.title: Install Ubuntu VM
tasks.description: Download Ubuntu Desktop ISO and set up a virtual machine in VirtualBox.

tasks.title: Complete Linux Basics tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp ‘Linux Command Line’ module, completing all exercises.

tasks.title: Create and edit files
tasks.description: Use nano/vi to create a log file, write sample entries, and view with cat/less.

tasks.title: Set up sudo and user groups
tasks.description: Add a new user, grant sudo rights, and verify with su command.

tasks.title: Reflect on command usage
tasks.description: Write a short note on three commands you found most useful and why.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop practical security abilities in log analysis, SIEM, incident response, and threat intel.

milestones.title: Log Analysis Foundations
milestones.outcome: Parse common log formats and extract useful security events.

tasks.title: Read syslog RFC
tasks.description: Study RFC 5424 on MDN to understand syslog structure.

tasks.title: Parse sample logs with grep
tasks.description: Use grep and awk on Linux to filter failed SSH attempts from a provided log file.

tasks.title: Create a log parsing script
tasks.description: Write a Bash script that extracts IPs from auth.log and saves to a CSV.

tasks.title: Document findings
tasks.description: Write a brief report describing what the script uncovered.

milestones.title: SIEM Tool Basics
milestones.outcome: Ingest logs into a free SIEM and build simple queries.

tasks.title: Deploy Elastic Stack Docker
tasks.description: Pull Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana images and start containers.

tasks.title: Ingest sample logs
tasks.description: Configure Filebeat to ship the auth.log used earlier into Elasticsearch.

tasks.title: Create a Kibana dashboard
tasks.description: Build a visual dashboard showing login failures over time.

tasks.title: Write a basic query
tasks.description: Use Kibana Discover to query for 'authentication failure' events.

tasks.title: Reflect on SIEM limits
tasks.description: Note two limitations you observed in the free version.

milestones.title: Incident Response Essentials
milestones.outcome: Follow a structured process to triage and contain a simulated incident.

tasks.title: Read NIST IR Playbook
tasks.description: Study the NIST 800‑61 Rev.2 incident response lifecycle on NIST.gov.

tasks.title: Create an IR checklist
tasks.description: Draft a one‑page checklist covering identification, containment, eradication, recovery.

tasks.title: Simulate a breach
tasks.description: Generate a fake malicious process on your VM and capture its artifacts.

tasks.title: Apply the checklist
tasks.description: Run through each checklist step to respond to the simulated breach.

tasks.title: Write a post‑mortem
tasks.description: Summarize actions taken, lessons learned, and next steps in a report.

milestones.title: Threat Intelligence Basics
milestones.outcome: Gather, analyze, and apply open‑source threat data to detections.

tasks.title: Explore MITRE ATT&CK
tasks.description: Navigate the MITRE ATT&CK matrix and note three techniques relevant to Windows.

tasks.title: Subscribe to a free feed
tasks.description: Add the AbuseIPDB API to your Logstash pipeline to enrich IP addresses.

tasks.title: Correlate intel with logs
tasks.description: Write a Kibana query that flags events matching ATT&CK technique IDs.

tasks.title: Summarize intel sources
tasks.description: Create a one‑page cheat sheet of top free intel feeds and their use cases.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate the skills you’ve acquired.

milestones.title: Home Lab Logging Setup
milestones.outcome: Deploy a fully functional logging pipeline and document its architecture.

tasks.title: Design lab diagram
tasks.description: Draw a network diagram showing VM, Logstash, Elasticsearch, Kibana, and data flow.

tasks.title: Implement the pipeline
tasks.description: Follow the Elastic Stack guide to ingest syslog from your Linux VM.

tasks.title: Write 5 detection rules
tasks.description: Create Kibana alerts for brute‑force SSH, privilege escalation, and suspicious ports.

tasks.title: Document the project
tasks.description: Write a README with setup steps, screenshots, and rule explanations.

tasks.title: Publish on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a public repo, add license, and include a short project overview.

milestones.title: CTF Incident Report
milestones.outcome: Produce a professional incident report based on a capture‑the‑flag challenge.

tasks.title: Select a relevant CTF
tasks.description: Choose a recent free CTF (e.g., Hack The Box Academy) with a detection scenario.

tasks.title: Collect evidence
tasks.description: Gather logs, screenshots, and command output during the challenge.

tasks.title: Write the report
tasks.description: Structure the report with executive summary, timeline, analysis, and remediation steps.

tasks.title: Peer review
tasks.description: Share the report in a security forum and incorporate feedback.

tasks.title: Add to portfolio site
tasks.description: Create a simple web page showcasing the report with key findings.

milestones.title: Detection Rule Set
milestones.outcome: Develop a reusable set of SIEM detection rules for common attacks.

tasks.title: Identify top 10 attack techniques
tasks.description: Use MITRE ATT&CK to pick ten high‑impact techniques for a SOC.

tasks.title: Write Sigma rules
tasks.description: Author Sigma rule files for each technique using the official schema.

tasks.title: Test rules in lab
tasks.description: Run the rules against your Elastic Stack logs and verify alerts fire.

tasks.title: Create documentation
tasks.description: Write a markdown guide explaining each rule, data sources, and tuning tips.

tasks.title: Share on GitHub
tasks.description: Publish the rule set repository and add a concise README.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, interview prep, and job‑search strategy.

milestones.title: Advanced Threat Hunting
milestones.outcome: Conduct a hypothesis‑driven hunt using your SIEM and threat intel.

tasks.title: Read threat hunting guide
tasks.description: Study the Elastic Threat Hunting guide (free) for methodology.

tasks.title: Define a hunt hypothesis
tasks.description: Pick a technique (e.g., credential dumping) and outline expected log artifacts.

tasks.title: Execute hunt queries
tasks.description: Write and run Kibana queries to search for the hypothesis across logs.

tasks.title: Document findings
tasks.description: Create a short report summarizing evidence and confidence level.

tasks.title: Discuss in community
tasks.description: Post your hunt results on a security subreddit for feedback.

milestones.title: Interview & Resume Prep
milestones.outcome: Present yourself confidently and land a security analyst role.

tasks.title: Craft a security resume
tasks.description: Use a free template to highlight projects, skills, and certifications.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) examples from your portfolio work.

tasks.title: Study common interview questions
tasks.description: Review the OWASP and SANS interview question lists and note key answers.

tasks.title: Mock interview with peer
tasks.description: Schedule a 30‑minute practice interview and receive feedback.

tasks.title: Review salary data
tasks.description: Check Glassdoor and Payscale for security analyst salary ranges in your region.

milestones.title: Certifications & Continuous Learning
milestones.outcome: Plan next credentials and a habit for staying current.

tasks.title: Research entry‑level certs
tasks.description: Compare CompTIA Security+, Cisco CCNA Security, and Splunk Fundamentals 1 on their official sites.

tasks.title: Create study schedule
tasks.description: Map out weekly study blocks for the chosen certification over the next 12 weeks.

tasks.title: Subscribe to a threat feed newsletter
tasks.description: Sign up for the SANS NewsBites daily digest to receive current alerts.

tasks.title: Set up weekly blog post
tasks.description: Write a short post each week summarizing a new security concept you learned.

tasks.title: Reflect on progress quarterly
tasks.description: Review your roadmap quarterly and adjust goals as needed.
